note: Invented data for demonstration. No real system, company, or test.
test_objective: Can the checkout journey support 500 concurrent users at 90+ transactions/second with checkout p95 at or under 2.0 seconds?

workload_model.iteration: search x2, add_to_cart x1, checkout x1
workload_model.pacing: fixed, one iteration every 20s per user

environment.payment_provider: third-party payment sandbox (shared test environment; rate limits undocumented)

sources.known_limitations: p95 values are per generator per minute; they cannot be averaged into a run-level p95.
